boundaries.label: Complete Integrated System (All 4 Pillars Present & Connected)

cards.title: Four Core Pillars (100% Implemented & Wired)
items: NIVED: Tree-sitter AST parsing, semantic chunking (CodeChunk), CodeDNA extraction
MITHUN: FAISS dense (bge-small-en-v1.5) + BM25 sparse + RRF fusion (k=60) + Explainable Reranker
HEYTISH: Bounded 4-step state machine (SEARCH→READ→EXPAND→RERANK) + NetworkX call graph
DURGA: FastAPI REST server + React evaluation frontend + 'Why This Result?' explainability

cards.title: API, UI & Demo Repositories (Current State)
items: frontend/App.jsx: Interactive query search, real-time 4-step trace timeline, Monaco-style source inspector
WhyThisResult.jsx: Multi-factor score attribution breakdown (semantic 35%, BM25 25%, symbol 25%, graph 15%)
demo_repo/: 6 realistic e-commerce modules (auth, db, orders, api) for end-to-end benchmark verification

cards.title: Evaluation Benchmark Results (eval_results.json)
items: Pass Rate: 100% (10/10 test queries across semantic, symbol, call-chain, and structural patterns)
Retrieval Quality: 0.80 MRR@5, 0.80 Recall@5, 0.85 File Recall@5
Performance: 33.6 ms median latency, 177.7 ms p95 latency on CPU (zero cloud/GPU dependency)
Reasoning Traces: 4 deterministic bounded steps per query with transparent candidate attribution
